content.title: 5 Revealing Analyst Questions From Sportsman's Warehouse’s Q2 Earnings Call
content.summary: Sportsman's Warehouse reported its second straight quarter of same-store sales growth and improved inventory positioning. CEO Paul Stone pointed to targeted merchandising and localized marketing as key drivers, particularly in Alaska and the fishing and hunting categories. However, margin headwinds and category mix weighed on profitability, with Stone noting, “attachment remains strong as average order value continues to be at all-time highs,” even as average unit retail in firearms declined.
